instruction: The Winkelmann Group is headquartered in a German town in Westphalia (Muensterland). A small river whose name begins with W (a tributary of the Ems, NOT the well-known Weser) flows through that town, and the town's stadium is named after that river. What is the name of that stadium?

provenance.source_benchmark: AssistantBench (Yoran et al., 2024); BrowseComp (Wei et al., 2025)
provenance.construction_method: Chain: Winkelmann Group -> town Ahlen -> river Werse -> Wersestadion. Single-value endpoint (the stadium); the stadium name needs the town and river, which need the company.
provenance.difficulty_axis: runtime-dependent chain: each search's result is the input to the next (a plan-upfront workflow cannot chain)

verification.memorization_no_tool: pending (must be non-memorized on the strongest model used)

provenance.note: Reused from the prior corpus (a-high-1), converted to a single-value endpoint.
